policy.rule: Fixed/direct CPO tariffs must not be hard-coded as timeless values. Each tariff source must have a refresh path, provenance, freshness metadata, history, and fail-safe behavior preserving the last validated value on parser/source failure.
policy.managedDefinition: at least one GitHub Actions workflow references the tariff file path or filename
policy.note: This is a conservative static audit. Unmanaged candidates require review; managed files can still need semantic refresh validation.
